name: quick
title: Quick change
description: A lightweight plan, change and check loop for small, low-risk changes that do not need a spec.

testCommand.description: Command that runs the full test suite

plan-change.description: Scope a small, low-risk change and agree on a short plan before editing. Use for quick fixes, tweaks and chores that do not need a spec.

make-change.description: Make the planned small change with minimal, focused edits. Use after the quick plan is agreed or when the check found problems.

BACK.description: The change is bigger or different than planned

check-change.description: Check the small change by running the tests, reviewing the diff and confirming the goal is met. Use after the change is made.

FAILED.description: Tests fail or the change does not meet its goal
